name: bitmovin-observability-ad-report
description: Portable Bitmovin ad-operations report skill packaged for Codex as a local plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Snapshot ad ops report for a Bitmovin Analytics license
interface.longDescription: Produces a structured, single-window ad-operations report for a Bitmovin Analytics license: the impression→start→quartile→completion funnel, advertiser and ad-system rankings, VAST/ad-server error breakdowns, pod-position cohorts, and ad startup-latency anomaly flags (AdOpsReport object), via the Bitmovin Observability MCP. The agent constructs queries and writes the narrative; tested scripts compute funnel drop-offs, concentration ranking, and threshold checks so the numbers are auditable. Does NOT explain why a metric moved between two windows — that belongs to the QoE root-cause-analysis skill.
defaultPrompt: Give me a weekly ad ops report for this license
How are our ads doing this week?
Break down our VAST errors by advertiser and ad system
